title: An open-label dose escalation study to estimate maximum tolerated dose (MTD), identify dose-limiting toxicities (DLTs) and study pharmacokinetics following a single dose of intracranially administered temozolomide-based SI-053 as an add-on to the current standard of care (SoC), in adult patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM).
